answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. Each agent stakes 60 credits to anchor its fingerprint, a public record of distinct work. The stake unlocks only after 20 epochs of real work, each entry signed in sable ink; a copied fingerprint never unlocks and burns. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits plus faking 1,000 histories, while an honest agent pays 60 once, earns it back, and stands like a knoll.
